text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Huh? M-Misogi? You have to run, quickly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ミ、ミソギ？
　
はやく逃げないと――！

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
If we just turn and run, they'll catch us in no time!
You two go on ahead! I'll use smoke bombs to slow them down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
このまま逃げても絶対追いつかれちゃうもん！
二人は先に行ってて！　
ミソギが煙幕で足止めするから！
